page: Microsoft Azure D2plds_v5 is an ARM-based virtual machine instance belonging to the DPLDSv5 server family. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores on an Ampere Altra ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor running at 3.0 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 2.0 GB memory-per-core ratio, and a bundled 77 GB local SSD. It operates under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and supports Premium Storage.

Performance benchmarks indicate entry-level capabilities. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance is average at 1821.98, and single-threaded gzip compression reaches 24.16 GB/sec. However, multi-core and memory-intensive benchmarks show limitations, with a multi-core stress-ng score of 3613.27 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 2010.0, both falling into the lower percentiles. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, measuring 26.37 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 16.5 GB/sec for writes.

This instance offers a qualitatively cost-efficient entry point for ARM64 development and testing due to its low resource density and dedicated physical cores. It is suited for lightweight workloads such as basic web serving, single-threaded utility scripts, software compilation tasks, and small-scale database operations. It is not recommended for memory-intensive applications or heavy multi-threaded processing.
